children: (NASDAQ: ZBRA), a global leader in digitizing and automating workflows to deliver intelligent operations, today announced its participation in the 6th United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) Digital Health Symposium this week at Seton Hall University. Tom Bianculli, Chief Technology Officer at Zebra Technologies, will deliver a keynote address focused on the importance of creating intelligent, connected healthcare ecosystems.

Bianculli’s keynote titled, “From Vision to Velocity: Powering SL2-10X with Frontline AI and Orchestrated Care,” will detail Zebra's strategy to move artificial intelligence (AI) from the back-office to the point of care. He will address how Frontline AI, which leverages on-device intelligence and real-time sensing, is essential for building the operational scaffolding to make the industry’s “Stay Left, Shift Left-10x” (SL2-10X) vision an executable reality.
The presentation will detail how Zebra's

connects providers, patients, and administrators to achieve this SL2-10X transformation. Zebra’s Orchestrated Care approach aims to improve clinical workflows, enhance patient safety, and deliver better outcomes through real-time data, point-of-care mobility and ecosystem-wide collaboration.

“Technology must be the catalyst for a more connected and intelligent future. At the UNGA Digital Health Symposium, we will share our vision for Frontline AI that moves beyond the cloud to empower clinicians and administrators at the point of care,” said Bianculli. “By integrating frontline AI with real-time asset visibility, we can minimize the estimated 30% of nursing hours lost to administrative tasks and create a system that is more efficient and fundamentally more human-centric.”

The premier international forum, themed "Stay Left, Shift Left-10X: The New Theory of the Business for Health," brings together global healthcare leaders, policymakers, technology innovators, academics, and industry executives to accelerate the transformation of healthcare through digital innovation, AI, data-driven care, and new models of health system delivery. Zebra's participation in the symposium underscores its commitment to advancing healthcare through innovation.

Zebra Technologies’ CTO Tom Bianculli will present a keynote address at the 6th UNGA Digital Health Symposium exploring how Frontline AI and real-time asset visibility serve as the technical foundation to eliminate clinical friction and unburden frontline clinicians.
Zebra's Orchestrated Care framework connects providers, patients, and administrators to improve clinical workflows, enhance patient safety, and deliver better outcomes.

By consolidating care team communications, secure messaging, and medical asset tracking onto clinical mobile devices, Zebra reduces administrative burnout and optimizes hospital resources so caregivers can prioritize direct patient care.

Zebra (NASDAQ: ZBRA) provides the foundation for intelligent operations with an award-winning portfolio of connected frontline, asset visibility and automation solutions which empower our customers to deploy AI on the frontline. Organizations globally across retail, manufacturing, transportation, logistics, healthcare, and other industries rely on us to deliver outcomes today while driving innovation for what’s next. Together with our partners, we create new ways of working that improve productivity and empower organizations to be better every day
